200 Returned if the Tenable MSSP Platform successfully created the evaluation account.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
Indicates whether or not Tenable MSSP successfully created the new
evaluation account.
string
A short message about the creation of the evaluation account.
string
The name of the evaluation account. The name is the specified email
domain followed by a dash and random integers. For example
example.com-830759035 .
string <uuid>
The UUID of the new evaluation account.
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters or if your request was improperly formatted.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in the Tenable MSSP Portal.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
integer
The HTTP status code of the error.
string
The standard HTTP error name.
country
required
success
message
name
uuid
statusCode
error
string
A brief message about the cause of the error.
